Sri Pankaj Kumar, learned AGA, for the State, apprised the Court that he has received the instructions, therefore, the instant anticipatory bail application may be finally disposed off.

2. Both the instant anticipatory bail applications arise from the same case crime number and applicants in both the anticipatory bail applications are also common, therefore, by common order both the instant anticipatory bail applications are being disposed of.

3. Heard Sri Anuj Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri P.K.Giri, learned Additional Advocate General assisted by Sri Pankaj Kumar, learned AGA, for the State.
4.

The instant anticipatory bail applications have been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on anticipatory bail arising out of FIR/Case Crime No.0309 of 2018, under Sections 467, 468, 471, 419, 420, 409, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Naini, District Prayagraj during pendency of the trial.

5. FIR of the present case was lodged on 16.3.2018 under Sections 419, 420 and 409 IPC against number of accused persons including applicant and according to the FIR, applicant and others were employees of Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology and Sciences (SHUATS) and they along with government salary were also drawing salary from the SHUATS from different Heads and, therefore, they misappropriated huge amount of public money.

entities.text: Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology and Sciences
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant was one of the Office Bearer of SHUATS and he alongwith as many as nineteen persons was made accused in the FIR of the present case.

7. He further submits that number of other accused persons, who were also named in the FIR alongwith the applicant, have already been released on anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 12.02.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No.14253 of 2023.

8. He further submits that the order dated 12.02.2024 passed by this Court is a very detailed order and the same has been annexed as Annexure No.6 to the affidavit filed in support of the instant anticipatory bail application.
9. He further submits that investigation against the applicant has been concluded and during investigation applicant was not arrested.
10. He further submits that summons has been issued to the applicant and therefore, applicant is having apprehension, if he will appear before the court concerned then he will be sent to jail.
11. He further submits that therefore, considering facts and circumstances of the case, applicant should be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

12. Per contra, learned Additional Advocate General appearing on behalf of the State, however,
opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact

sentences.text: 13. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

14. From the record, it reflects that in the FIR as many as 20 persons including applicant were made accused and as per allegation, applicant and others being Office Bearers of SHUATS misappropriated huge amount of public fund as apart from the Government salary they were also withdrawing the salary from the SHUATS i.e. University but it reflects that vide order dated 12.02.2024, number of other accused persons, who were also named in the FIR alongwith applicant,
have already been released on anticipatory bail with a very detailed order passed by this Court and case of applicant is at par with them.
15.

Further, it appears that during investigation applicant was not arrested and now charge-sheet has been filed and summons has been issued, therefore, apprehension of custody/arrest raised by learned counsel for the applicant cannot be brushed aside at this stage.
16.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till the conclusion of the trial.
17. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail anticipatory application is allowed.
